updateIssue.title: [differential-fuzz] shard=update-advancing: 12 differential mismatch(es) vs Oxigraph (first seed=4132943222, mode=baseline)

nodes.body:
> 🤖 **SPARQ agent** — auto-filed by the nightly differential-fuzz lane (bead sq-0iqzw). [FABLE-5]

The nightly sparq-vs-Oxigraph differential fuzzer found **8 non-adjudicated mismatch(es)** in shard `update-advancing` (category `update`, mode `baseline`, seed window 4141200000+150000).

- **Failing seeds:** 4141222487, 4141222535, 4141222571, 4141222576, 4141222599, 4141222612, 4141222617, 4141222622
- **Deterministic replay:** `cargo run -p sparq-bench --release -- fuzz 4141222487 1 update`
- **Run:** https://github.com/sparq-org/sparq/actions/runs/34458877088
- **Bead:** `sq-dfamfmg` (P1, auto-appended; push best-effort)
- **Artifact:** `differential-repro-update-advancing` on the run above (full log)

The adjudicated divergence classes in `bench/differential-divergences.json` (sq-eibog cross-family `=`/`!=`; sq-ai2wa bnode-vs-IRI) are already excluded by the comparator, so this is a candidate **wrong-answer bug** — in sparq or (less likely) Oxigraph — until adjudicated.

sharpIssue.title: supply-chain: brace-expansion (+ postcss) advisories have no reachable upstream patch — monitor for a fix
sharpIssue.body:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent — autonomous orchestration for sparq.

GitHub's managed **Dependabot Updates** workflow is repeatedly concluding
`security_update_not_possible` on this repo's **npm** graph (root
`package-lock.json`). No PR is opened, the alert stays open, and the job check-run
`Dependabot` REDs. This issue is the tracking record for that state — deliberately
**not** a `dependabot.yml` ignore entry, which would also hide the future fix.

## Current state (verified 2026-07-25)

### `brace-expansion` — 4 open alerts (#25, #26, #27, #46)

Dependabot job [run 30136987253](https://github.com/sparq-org/sparq/actions/runs/30136987253)
(job definition `{"command":"security","dependencies":["brace-expansion"]}`) ends:

```
security_update_not_possible
  "dependency-name": "brace-expansion",
  "explanation": "A patched version exists for brace-expansion,
                  but the available update path still resolves it to 1.1.16"
```

**Honest root cause — an upstream patch DOES exist; it is just not reachable.**
The lock carries four independent `brace-expansion` instances, each pinned by a
different `minimatch` generation:

| instance | version | pinned by | range |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node_modules/brace-expansion` | 1.1.15 | `minimatch@3.1.5` | `^1.1.7` |
| `node_modules/glob/node_modules/brace-expansion` | 2.1.1 | `minimatch@9.0.9` | `^2.0.2` |
| `node_modules/readdir-glob/node_modules/brace-expansion` | 2.1.1 | `minimatch@5.1.9` | `^2.0.1` |
| `…/@typescript-eslint/typescript-estree/node_modules/brace-expansion` | 5.0.6 | `minimatch@10.2.5` | `^5.0.5` |

The advisory set includes one entry whose affected range is **`<= 5.0.7`**, so the
only unaffected release is **5.0.8**. From `^1.1.7` / `^2.0.x` the resolver can reach
at most `1.1.16` / `2.1.2` — both still `<= 5.0.7`. Clearing the alerts therefore
needs the **`minimatch` dependents** moved forward (or deduped), not a
`brace-expansion` bump — which is outside what a Dependabot security update will do.

### `postcss` — same failure class (alert #45)

[Run 30136987015](https://github.com/sparq-org/sparq/actions/runs/30136987015):
`security_update_not_possible`, `"explanation": "@tailwindcss/postcss@4.3.1 requires
postcss@8.5.15"` / `"next@15.5.21 requires postcss@8.4.31"` — patched at 8.5.18, held
down by direct dependents' pins.

`sharp` (alert #32) failed the same way three times on 2026-07-22.

## Impact so far

The `Dependabot` check-run was **GATING**, so this unactionable upstream condition
red `main` twice in a row under the stop-the-line rule:

- gate [30131008188](https://github.com/sparq-org/sparq/actions/runs/30131008188) (2026-07-24T22:29Z) — `- ✗ Dependabot: failure`
- gate [30136978362](https://github.com/sparq-org/sparq/actions/runs/30136978362) (2026-07-25T00:46Z) — `- ✗ Dependabot: failure`

In both cases it was the **only** gating failure. The merge queue was *not* blocked
(PR #3764 merged at 00:44 during the second red), so the cost was false-alarm +
telemetry noise, not stalled merges. That gating half is fixed separately by making
the GitHub-managed `Dependabot` check-run non-gating via a fail-closed exact-name
allow-list in `scripts/ci_summary_gate.py` — see the linked PR. **This issue tracks
the advisory itself, which is not suppressed anywhere.**

## Why there is no VEX / supply-chain record for this

`supply-chain/vex.cdx.json` is held in **set equality** with `deny.toml
[advisories].ignore` by the GATING `scripts/check-vex-deny-drift.py` check — it is
structurally a **cargo/RustSec** artifact (5 ids today, all RUSTSEC/GHSA crate
advisories). Adding an npm GHSA there would red that gate as unjustified drift. The
markdown precedent, `supply-chain/gui-tauri-advisories.md`, is a *Rust* workspace
disposition wired into `compliance/cra/evidence.md`. So an issue is the honest home
for this npm finding.

## Known gap this exposes

There is **no in-repo npm vulnerability gate**. `cargo deny check advisories` (inside
`supply-chain gates (deny + vet + SBOM + VEX + OpenSSF + js-sbom)`) covers the cargo
graph only; the `js-sbom` step *generates* CycloneDX SBOMs and does not fail on
advisories. Dependabot alerts are therefore the sole npm surveillance surface — which
is exactly why nothing here dismisses or ignores them.

## What to do when a patch becomes reachable

1. Dependabot retries automatically (weekly cadence + on each new alert); the moment
   an update path reaches an unaffected version it opens the PR and the
   `Dependabot` check goes green with no action needed here.
2. To close it sooner, move the *dependents*: bump/dedupe the packages pinning
   `minimatch@3`/`@5` in the root lock (`npm dedupe`, or bump the direct dev deps
   that pull them) so `brace-expansion >= 5.0.8` becomes resolvable. Verify with
   `npm ls brace-expansion` + a clean `npm ci`.
3. For `postcss`, the block is `next` / `@tailwindcss/postcss` pins — it clears on the
   next `next` minor that requires `postcss >= 8.5.18`.
4. Then close this issue and re-check `gh api repos/sparq-org/sparq/dependabot/alerts?state=open`.

**Do NOT** add `dependabot.yml` `ignore:` entries for these packages — that would
suppress the future patch notification too.

## Follow-up worth considering (separate scope)

Add a real npm advisory gate (`npm audit --audit-level=high` or `osv-scanner` over
the JS locks) so the npm graph has in-repo enforcement rather than alert-only
surveillance. Deliberately not bundled here: it needs a tolerated-findings policy
first, since it would red on exactly these unreachable advisories.
